# In-place depth-2: dst[i] += a[i]*2 uses Mul+Add on int32.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func DaxpyInt32s(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += a[i] * 3
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func DaxpyInt32s(dst, a []int32) {
	_vcAInt32s0 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(3)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a, 0, len(dst), 0, len(a)) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] += a[i] * 3
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			{
				_w1 := dst[:len(dst):len(dst)]
				_count := len(_w1)
				_w2 := a[:_count:_count]
				_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastInt32s(0).Len()
				for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
					_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
					_v1 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2)
					_v2 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1)
					_v1.Mul(_vcAInt32s0).Add(_v2).Store(_c1)
					_v3 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[_lanes:])
					_v4 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v3.Mul(_vcAInt32s0).Add(_v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
					_v5 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
					_v6 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v5.Mul(_vcAInt32s0).Add(_v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
					_v7 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
					_v8 := simd.LoadInt32s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
					_v7.Mul(_vcAInt32s0).Add(_v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				}
				for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
					_v9 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w2[_i:])
					_v10 := simd.LoadInt32s(_w1[_i:])
					_v9.Mul(_vcAInt32s0).Add(_v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
				}
				for _i < _count {
					_v11, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w2[_i:])
					_v12, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(_w1[_i:])
					_v11.Mul(_vcAInt32s0).Add(_v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
					_i += _n
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := []int32{1, 2, 3, 4}
	a := []int32{10, 20, 30, 40}
	test.DaxpyInt32s(dst, a)
	fmt.Println(dst[0], dst[1], dst[2], dst[3])
}
-- testmain/output --
31 62 93 124
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func DaxpyInt32s(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += a[i] * 3
	}
}
